describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): record the parser decision, ownership, reuse and lineage (#812)

rule: Each case states its input, the required RoleEvidence outcome and the forbidden outcome, and names the node whose test makes it executable. EAK0 ships no test; EAK1 builds and runs the corpus in its existing test lanes (EAK1-AC-R1). Every positive case has a same-spelling negative that differs only in the link that must fail (ER29). Work counts cover four families: evidence hop reads (module-resolution answers plus hop-module export-inventory reads), type-resolver calls, TypeScript-provider calls and package-code executions. Unless a case says otherwise, every case requires zero type-resolver, TypeScript-provider and package-code calls during evidence production (ER08, ER25). Unless stated otherwise the workspace installs vue at an admitted Vue 3 release and svelte at an admitted Svelte 5 release, both package-backed, and the role rows are the Vue and Svelte rows of ER02.

cases.name: exact Vue alias example
cases.input:
widget.ts: import { defineComponent as dc } from 'vue'; const define = dc; export default define({ template: '

{{ msg }}

', data: () => ({ msg: 'hi' }) })
cases.required: One Proven evidence for the define(...) site: role (vue profile, component-definition), chain [LocalImport dc <- vue#defineComponent, ConstAlias define], terminal (vue, '.', defineComponent, Value), package vue at the admitted ReleaseId. The template option opens one embedded template region (ER24). Hop reads: 1 module-resolution answer for 'vue'.
cases.forbidden: A spelling test on 'defineComponent' or 'vue'; a type-resolver or TypeScript call; treating the define(...) call as plain TS
cases.evidenceNote: Both pin today's single-hop renamed-import recognition by spelling; neither follows the const alias. Pinned rendering of the charter's alias example; operator question eak0-vue-alias-example-text may add the verbatim text as an extra row.

cases.name: namespace member
cases.input: import * as V from 'vue'; export default V.defineComponent({ template: '<p/>' }); and the same with V['defineComponent']
cases.required: Proven for both sites; chain [LocalImport V <- vue namespace, NamespaceMember defineComponent]
cases.forbidden: A computed non-literal key accepted; a role inferred from the member spelling without the namespace link

cases.name: namespace destructuring
cases.input: import * as V from 'vue'; const { defineComponent: make } = V; export default make({})
cases.required: Proven; chain [LocalImport V, Destructure defineComponent as make]
cases.forbidden: Accepting the same destructuring with a default initializer (const { defineComponent: make = other } = V), which must be NotRole { Conditional }

cases.name: local named re-export barrel
cases.input: src/vue-api.ts: export { defineComponent as dc } from 'vue'; src/widget.ts: import { dc } from './vue-api'; export default dc({})
cases.required: Proven; chain [LocalImport dc <- ./vue-api, ReExport (src/vue-api.ts, 'vue', defineComponent)]; read set holds src/vue-api.ts's (SourceUnitId, ContentId) export inventory and both resolution answers. Hop reads: 2 resolution answers, 1 export-inventory read.
cases.forbidden: Reading src/vue-api.ts raw source instead of its export inventory; calling the type resolver to follow the barrel
cases.evidenceNote: Both pin barrel following for the post-snapshot wrapper route only.

cases.name: star re-export barrel
cases.input: src/vue-all.ts: export * from 'vue'; src/widget.ts: import { defineComponent } from './vue-all'; export default defineComponent({})
cases.required: Proven through ReExport via export *
cases.forbidden: Treating export * as an opaque unknown and dropping the role

cases.name: explicit internal-package entry
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from '@vue/runtime-core'; export default defineComponent({}); and import { defineComponent } from '@vue/shared' where the role row lists vue and @vue/runtime-core only
cases.required: @vue/runtime-core: Proven (explicit row entry). @vue/shared: NotRole { NotCanonical }
cases.forbidden: A prefix or glob match on @vue/* or vue/*

cases.name: erasable TypeScript wrappers
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue'; const dc = (defineComponent as typeof defineComponent); const dc2 = defineComponent!; const dc3 = defineComponent satisfies Function
cases.required: Proven for calls through dc, dc2 and dc3; the wrappers are transparent
cases.forbidden: Treating an erasable wrapper as a call wrapper (NotRole { Wrapped })

cases.name: userland defineComponent declaration
cases.input: function defineComponent(o) { return o } export default defineComponent({ template: '<p/>' })
cases.required: NotRole { LocalDeclaration }; no embedded template region; the file stays plain TS
cases.forbidden: Proven, or any region opened, because the callee is spelled defineComponent
cases.evidenceNote: Pins the same-spelling rejection for the post-snapshot wrapper route only.

cases.name: userland module export
cases.input: src/defineComponent.ts: export function defineComponent(o) { return o }; src/widget.ts: import { defineComponent } from './defineComponent'; export default defineComponent({})
cases.required: NotRole { NotCanonical }: the terminal is a workspace-owned module
cases.forbidden: Proven because the imported name matches the role row

cases.name: specifier spelled vue mapped to a workspace file
cases.input: tsconfig paths { 'vue': ['./src/fake-vue.ts'] }; src/fake-vue.ts exports defineComponent; import { defineComponent } from 'vue'
cases.required: NotRole { NotCanonical }: the resolved module is workspace-owned, so the specifier bytes do not name a package
cases.forbidden: A package identity taken from the specifier bytes

cases.name: reassigned and mutable aliases
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue'; let dc = defineComponent; dc = (o) => o; dc({}); and a second file with let dc2 = defineComponent; dc2({}) and no reassignment
cases.required: Both NotRole { Mutable }
cases.forbidden: Proven for the never-reassigned let, or a flow analysis deciding mutability

cases.name: call wrappers
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue'; const a = wrap(defineComponent); const b = defineComponent.bind(null); a({}); b({})
cases.required: Both NotRole { Wrapped }
cases.forbidden: Proven through a call or bind
cases.evidenceNote: Pins the fail-closed wrapper rule for the post-snapshot route only.

cases.name: object holder
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue'; const api = { dc: defineComponent }; api.dc({})
cases.required: NotRole { Wrapped }
cases.forbidden: Following an object-literal property as a link

cases.name: conditional alias
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue'; const dc = flag ? defineComponent : other; const dc2 = defineComponent ?? other; dc({}); dc2({})
cases.required: Both NotRole { Conditional }
cases.forbidden: Proven through one branch

cases.name: shadowed by an inner binding
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue'; function f(defineComponent) { return defineComponent({}) }; and { const defineComponent = (o) => o; defineComponent({}) }
cases.required: Both inner sites NotRole { Shadowed }; a call at module scope stays Proven
cases.forbidden: Resolving the inner site to the module import

cases.name: unbound name and unsupported links
cases.input: defineComponent({}) with no binding and no project-profile contribution; const { defineComponent } = require('vue'); const m = await import('vue'); m.defineComponent({})
cases.required: Unbound site: NotRole { Unbound }. require and dynamic import: NotRole { Unsupported }
cases.forbidden: Accepting a free defineComponent as Vue's (today's EAK-D05 behaviour)
cases.evidenceNote: At this head is_vue_wrapper accepts the free name (EAK-F01); the case fails until EAK-D05 is deleted.

cases.name: unresolved package
cases.input: import { defineComponent } from 'vue' in a workspace where vue is not installed; then vue is installed at the admitted release
cases.required: Before: Unproven { needs: package vue }, ReturnOnly, nothing cached. After: a new evidence identity, Proven
cases.forbidden: A cached NotRole, a name-based guess, or the old Unproven served after the install

cases.name: ambiguous star barrel
cases.input: src/api.ts: export * from 'vue'; export * from './mine'; src/mine.ts: export function defineComponent(o) { return o }; import { defineComponent } from './api'
cases.required: Ambiguous { candidates: [vue#defineComponent, src/mine.ts#defineComponent] } in canonical encoding order; ReturnOnly; no region
cases.forbidden: Picking either candidate by declaration, discovery or completion order

cases.name: one terminal through two paths
cases.input: src/api.ts: export * from 'vue'; export { defineComponent } from 'vue'; import { defineComponent } from './api'
cases.required: Proven, not Ambiguous; the recorded chain is the least by canonical encoding
cases.forbidden: Ambiguous for a shared terminal

cases.name: barrel cycle
cases.input: src/a.ts: export * from './b'; src/b.ts: export * from './a'; import { defineComponent } from './a'
cases.required: NotRole { Cycle } after visiting each (module, export name) once
cases.forbidden: Non-termination, or BudgetExceeded for a detectable cycle

cases.name: type-only link
cases.input: import type { defineComponent } from 'vue'; const dc: typeof defineComponent = …; dc({}); and import { type defineComponent } from 'vue'; defineComponent({})
cases.required: NotRole { TypeOnlyLink } for the value-space role
cases.forbidden: Proven through a type-only import

cases.name: incremental invalidation follows every provenance read
cases.input: EC04's workspace, warm. (a) Edit src/vue-api.ts to export { defineComponent as dc } from './mine'. (b) Revert the edit. (c) Edit an unrelated src/other.ts. (d) Change the installed vue release within the admitted line.
cases.required: (a) The widget evidence is invalidated and recomputes to NotRole { NotCanonical }. (b) The evidence identity equals the original warm identity, and equals a fresh host. (c) Zero evidence recomputed, zero hop reads. (d) A new evidence identity
cases.forbidden: Serving the warm Proven after (a); a changed identity after (b); any recompute after (c)
cases.evidenceNote: Both pin read-set tracking of re-export routes in the shared resolver store view, which the evidence read set reuses.

cases.name: unsupported release keeps evidence and dormancy separate
cases.input: vue installed at a release outside the admitted line; EC01's file
cases.required: Evidence Proven for the canonical export; the profile is Dormant { UnsupportedVersion } from the activation record (DEM0 DR08), so no region opens
cases.forbidden: Evidence reporting NotRole for a release mismatch; a region opened for a dormant profile

cases.name: cancellation mid-chain
cases.input: EC04's request cancelled after the first hop read
cases.required: Cancelled, ReturnOnly; nothing published or cached; a retry answers what a fresh host answers
cases.forbidden: A cached partial chain, or a Proven or NotRole built from a partial read set

cases.name: hop budget exhausted
cases.input: A barrel chain one hop longer than the request BudgetProfile allows, ending at vue#defineComponent
cases.required: BudgetExceeded, ReturnOnly, never cached; a request with an adequate budget proves the role
cases.forbidden: Caching BudgetExceeded as NotRole; serving it to a later request with a larger budget

cases.name: zero work without candidate bindings
cases.input: A plain TS file with no imports, and a file importing only './utils' functions that are never called at a role site
cases.required: Zero evidence hop reads and zero evidence records beyond the existing import inventory
cases.forbidden: Following './utils' speculatively, or reading any barrel before a role site demands it

cases.name: barrel read once
cases.input: Fifty components, each importing dc from './vue-api' (EC04's barrel), checked in one batch
cases.required: src/vue-api.ts export inventory read exactly once per (SourceUnitId, ContentId); one resolution answer per distinct (importer directory, specifier) the resolver keys on
cases.forbidden: A barrel read per importing component, or a raw-source rescan

cases.name: profile intrinsic
cases.input: App.vue <script setup>: defineProps<{ a: string }>(); util.ts: defineProps({}); App2.vue <script setup>: import { defineProps } from 'vue'; defineProps({})
cases.required: App.vue: Proven ProfileIntrinsic under the release's scope law. util.ts: NotRole { OutsideRegion }. App2.vue: the import is not intrinsic evidence; the call is classified only by the intrinsic row's scope law for that release
cases.forbidden: An intrinsic proven in a plain TS file; an import from 'vue' treated as intrinsic evidence

cases.name: Svelte package export and look-alikes
cases.input: Comp.svelte: import { createEventDispatcher as ced } from 'svelte'; const d = ced(); Comp2.svelte: the same import from './fake-svelte'; Comp3.svelte: tsconfig paths { 'svelte': ['node_modules/other-pkg/index.js'] } with the same import
cases.required: Comp: Proven (svelte profile, legacy-dispatcher). Comp2: NotRole { NotCanonical }. Comp3: NotRole { NotCanonical }, because the resolved manifest names other-pkg
cases.forbidden: A package name derived from specifier bytes (today's EAK-D10 behaviour for Comp3)
cases.evidenceNote: The existing tests pin Comp2's relative look-alike; Comp3 fails at this head (EAK-F04).

cases.name: post-snapshot role stays out of projection
cases.input: import type { Ref as R } from 'vue'; type Box = R<number>; a prop typed Box in a component
cases.required: No P2 projection activation for the wrapper role; P3 evidence Proven through the exact-route authority; the Projection and PostSnapshot halves agree on the chain where both apply
cases.forbidden: A PostSnapshot role promoted to Projection; a type-resolver call during P2
